proposal_title: Alignment of Handoff Index with Normative Repo Blueprints
domain_specific_rationale: As the Developer Experience and AI Handoff Architect with mandatory signoff authority, eliminating hallucinated or unbacked architectural claims from handoff documents is paramount. In prior candidate artifacts (FINAL_IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF_INDEX.md and AGENT_BUILD_PACKET_INDEX.md), phantom requirements were introduced that directly contradicted the normative architecture—such as claiming a dedicated 'SecretEnclave' hardware module (contradicting in-memory environment-variable secret handling in R07), a 'gRPC port on R10 FlowKit Bridge' (contradicting the internal HTTP/JSON-RPC IPC protocol), and a 'raw WebSocket server on R13 Operator Console' (contradicting HTTP REST + Server-Sent Events). These phantom claims poison the context window of independent coding agents, causing catastrophic implementation divergence and failed repo handoffs. CP-021 cleanses all unbacked claims, restoring strict 1:1 parity between agent build packets and normative repo blueprints, ensuring seamless, zero-guesswork handoffs for autonomous developers.
capability_impact: Directly safeguards Handoff Trustworthiness, Agent Task Isolation, and Developer Velocity across all capabilities (CAP-01 through CAP-19), preventing hallucinated implementation efforts and ensuring autonomous agents execute with 100% architectural fidelity.
residual_risk: Future specification revisions might introduce documentation drift if agent build packets are updated out-of-sync with blueprints. Mitigated by automated CI verification scripts that cross-check agent packet API definitions against normative blueprint contracts.
